observations: A side-facing head rendered in solid black fill is outlined by a thin pink-mauve contour line; a jagged yellow line traces the crown and back of the skull, spiking outward in short sharp points.
One eye area holds a small tight cluster of blue and white looping lines against the black mass, the only interior detail on the face; a short red zigzag marks the mouth.
The lower body is outlined in blue against the dark teal background, with zigzag line behavior repeated across the torso; a small blue mark sits in the lower-left corner.
reading: The figure is mostly darkness—a black mass held by a thin pink contour and a jagged yellow edge that bristles along the top. Against that near-total absence, the small blue-white eye cluster and the red mouth read as sparks rather than features. The blue body outline below carries the same restless zigzag rhythm, so the agitation is not confined to the face.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #276 and nnxyz nnotb #278. Where #276 layers dense color fills and #278 uses bright flat pinks and blues, #277 strips the figure to black mass and sparse accent lines.

connections.reason: Both works use the same jagged zigzag line as a repeated border element, but #278 deploys it across bright pink and blue fills while #277 sets it against near-total black, sharpening the contrast between the two approaches.

Both works build a head form from a dark filled mass with sparse bright line accents, though #290 layers translucent color planes inside the skull where #277 leaves the interior almost entirely empty.

lookingQuestion: What does the placement of the blue-white eye cluster—the only interior mark on the black face—draw your attention toward or away from?
ambiguities: The small blue mark in the lower-left corner resembles a recurring artist mark seen in comparison images but cannot be confirmed as identical from this image alone.
